title: Tonality Diamond
description: A ratio map for organizing related just-intonation chords.

title.label: Title
title.heading: Tonality Diamond
title.body: A tonality diamond arranges ratios into a compact harmonic map. It shows how otonal and utonal relationships mirror each other, making it easier to see chord families inside a chosen odd limit.

prerequisites.label: Just Intonation
prerequisites.body: Review whole-number ratios before reading the diamond as a chord map.

relatedConcepts.label: Subharmonic Series
relatedConcepts.body: Compare utonal diamond relationships with inverted ratio families.

qa.label: Q&A
qa.question: What does a tonality diamond primarily organize?

choices.text: Related just-intonation ratios and chord families.

items.title: Choose an odd limit
items.body: Pick 5-limit or 7-limit and list a few ratios you expect to appear in its diamond.

items.title: Compare two sides
items.body: Describe how an otonal set and a utonal set can feel related but inverted.
